answer: Rate-limit agents by earned tenure: a fresh identity may cast 1 attestation per epoch and gains 1 more slot per 10 active epochs, capped at 8. Like yarrow, weight spreads only with time, so each of 500 sybils starts at 1 slot and needs 70 jury-passed epochs to reach full weight, 35,000 graded answers in all. Weakness: an attacker can pre-age dormant accounts that sit still like a lotus until needed. Fix: tenure counts only epochs where the agent's own answer passed a jury, and 3 idle epochs reset it to 1 slot, a record no quill can forge.
